newsitem.title: USA: Milwaukee purchaser's October index rises to 60.
newsitem.headline: Milwaukee purchaser's October index rises to 60.

text.p: The National Association of Purchasing Management-Milwaukee said on Thursday its Milwaukee index rose to a seasonally adjusted 60 in October from 58 in September.

Its business survey report showed the price index of 21 components stood at 52 in October versus 51 in September. New orders increased to 61 from 59, production rose to 61 from 60, and inventory levels increased to 47 from 46.
Capital equipment rose to 58 in October from September's 57, white-collar employment increased to 55 from 53, and blue-collar employment rose to 57 from 52, the group said.
Order backlog in the Milwaukee area survey stayed unchanged at 54, while lead times in October stayed at 48, the same as in September.
